definitions.gloss: later; shortly; in due course; at a later date
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something will be communicated, decided, or done at a later time. Formal and commonly used in business correspondence and official notices.

examples.japanese: {詳細|しょうさい}は{追|お}って{連絡|れんらく}します。
examples.english: I will contact you with the details later.

examples.japanese: {日程|にってい}は{追|お}ってお{知|し}らせいたします。
examples.english: We will inform you of the schedule at a later date.

examples.japanese: {審査結果|しんさけっか}は{追|お}って{書面|しょめん}にて{通知|つうち}いたしますので、しばらくお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: The screening results will be communicated in writing at a later date, so please wait.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverb used in business emails, official announcements, and notices. Implies that additional information will follow, but the exact timing is not specified. Very common in the phrase {追|お}って{連絡|れんらく}します.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}って{連絡|れんらく}する (to contact later)
- {追|お}ってお{知|し}らせする (to notify later)
- {追|お}って{通知|つうち}する (to give notice later)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|のち}ほど: later — slightly less formal, more conversational
- {改|あらた}めて: again, separately — implies doing something again properly or at a better time
